mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate contracting consumer demand that triggers negative earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of INDPRO < 95.0 periods, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of HOUST rising periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS monthly growth > 0.5%) signals rising consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% periods, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production rising above 105.0 signals robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of INDPRO > 105.0 periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
